A和B在图书馆遇见发生一件小事。

TITLE: THE BORROWED COAT

A enters a modern library. She sees B reading at a table, sets a small knife aside, and speaks with her.

角色A：你果然在这儿。
角色B：刀放桌上吧。

B removes her outer garment, places it on a chair, picks up the knife, and leaves.

角色B：我拿走了。

A removes her own outer layer, puts on B's garment, and spins happily.

角色A·派生：还挺合身。

END.

A和B在图书馆遇见发生一件小事。
A走到图书馆，看到B正在读书，把刀放到一边，同B交谈。

content.script:
TITLE: THE BORROWED COAT

A enters a modern library. She sees B reading at a table, sets a small knife aside, and speaks with her.

角色A：你果然在这儿。
角色B：刀放桌上吧。

B removes her outer garment, places it on a chair, picks up the knife, and leaves.

角色B：我拿走了。

A removes her own outer layer, puts on B's garment, and spins happily.

角色A·派生：还挺合身。

END.

TITLE: THE BORROWED COAT

A enters a modern library. She sees B reading at a table, sets a small knife aside, and speaks with her.

角色A：你果然在这儿。
角色B：刀放桌上吧。

角色B：我拿走了。

A removes her own outer layer, puts on B's garment, and spins happily.

角色A·派生：还挺合身。

END.
